marta: Planning a coordinated outreach + tagging job to add `enablement_pending` and create an enablement_task in the task queue for orphan accounts. Criteria: created >=7d, zero enablement_events last 90d, health_score < 0.35, not pilot/enterprise, not flagged 'no-contact'. Posting filter + safety checks for ops review. @sunil @trina @cory

sunil: Drop the exact query and what you plan to write back. We need snapshot + trace_id so we can revert. Also exclude accounts with converted_at in last 30d and those with owner_claimed=true in last 14d.

marta: Dry-run SQL below (will write snapshot to cs_health_snapshot_outreach_v1 and not mutate while dry_run=true):
```sql
SELECT a.account_id, a.created_at, COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) AS enablement_events, h.health_score, s.status, s.converted_at, o.claimed_at, a.metadata->>'pilot' AS pilot_flag
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM enablement_events WHERE created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY account_id) ev USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN cs_health h USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING (account_id)
LEFT JOIN owners o USING (account_id)
WHERE a.created_at <= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND COALESCE(ev.cnt,0) = 0
  AND h.health_score < 0.35
  AND (s.converted_at IS NULL OR s.converted_at <= now() - interval '30 days')
  AND (o.claimed_at IS NULL OR o.claimed_at <= now() - interval '14 days')
  AND a.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM account_flags WHERE flag IN ('no-contact','enterprise'))
LIMIT 300;
```

trina: Good. A few operational asks: (1) snapshot includes owner_claimed boolean and health_score, (2) create task with trace_id so tasks are reversible, (3) pilot size 300, run metrics checks for owner claim flips and health_score deltas. If >0.75% of rows have owner_claimed flips or >1% show health_score delta >0.45, abort.

cory: Add a short owner webhook so product specialists receive a digest (no auto-email). Also exclude accounts with metadata->>'no_enablement' = 'true'.

marta: Updated job config (dry-run):
```yaml
job_name: outreach_enablement_task_pilot_20260324
dry_run: true
pilot_limit: 300
snapshot_table: cs_health_snapshot_outreach_v1
include_fields: [account_id, health_score, owner_claimed, metadata]
exclude_flags: ['no-contact','enterprise']
exclude_metadata: { 'no_enablement': 'true' }
owner_notification: webhook://cs/digest_enablement
task_create: true
trace_id_prefix: outreach_pilot_20260324
abort_conditions:
  owner_claim_flip_pct: 0.0075
  health_delta_pct: 0.01
```

sunil: Approving dry-run pilot with those controls. Ops note: prepare rollback runbook with script to remove tags/tasks by trace_id and restore cs_health_snapshot_outreach_v1 if needed. Add a short windowed run (1h) so we can monitor telemetry.
